newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE seeks buyer for mobile phone unit -- magazine.
newsitem.headline: RWE seeks buyer for mobile phone unit -- magazine.

text.p: Diversified German conglomerate RWE AG is seeking a buyer for its mobile phone company Talkline, the Spiegel magazine reported at the weekend, without naming sources.
Spiegel said RWE was keen to sell the unit to Thyssen AG in return for Thyssen's 30 percent share in the E-Plus mobile phone network.
Talkline has around 500,000 clients and annual sales of 500 million marks, making it Germany's second largest mobile phone company without its own network, Spiegel said.
The report could not be immediately confirmed.
RWE chief executive Dietmar Kuhnt told shareholders in December that the company was interested in a larger stake in E-Plus.
